messages.content: You solve tasks. If you need to calculate or look up a fact, call tools instead of guessing. When the answer is ready, write it as the last line in the format FINAL: <answer>. For numeric tasks put only the number after FINAL, for factual questions a short phrase.
What was the number of participants in the anti-war protest in Japan in April 2026?

[2026 in Japan]
April 8 – Thirty thousand people participate in an anti-war and anti-constitutional amendment protest in front of the National Diet Building in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo. Similar protests are also held in 150 other places across Japan.
